title: goldrieve/vsgseq2 pipeline parameters
description: Assembly, identification and quantification of VSGs from VSG-seq data

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

samplesheet.description: Path to comma-separated file with columns `sample`, `r1` and `r2`. Leave `r2` empty for single-end reads.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. Defaults to `results/<today>`.

today.description: Date stamp used in the default output directory. Defaults to today's date (ddMMMYY).

mode.description: `full` assembles each sample with Trinity. `analyse` reuses the assemblies given by `--assemblies`.

assemblies.description: Glob of pre-assembled transcripts used in `analyse` mode, named `<sample>_trinity.Trinity.fasta`. Defaults to the tutorial assemblies in `data/tutorial_assemblies`.

reference_options.title: Reference options
reference_options.description: BLAST databases and genome used to identify and quantify VSGs. Defaults point to the T. brucei files in `data/`.

vsg_db.description: VSG BLAST database. All files matching `<vsg_db>*` are staged. Defaults to `data/blastdb/concatAnTattb427.fa`.

notvsg_db.description: Non-VSG BLAST database. All files matching `<notvsg_db>*` are staged. Defaults to `data/blastdb/vsgseq2NOTvsgs.fa`.

full_vsg_db.description: Optional FASTA of VSGs to add to the assembled VSGome, such as `data/blastdb/concatAnTattb427_full.fa`.

genome.description: Genome FASTA used as Salmon decoys. Defaults to `data/genome/TriTrypDB-67_TbruceiEATRO1125_Genome.fasta`.

decoys.description: Salmon decoy names for the genome. Defaults to `data/genome/TriTrypDB-67_TbruceiEATRO1125_Genome_decoys.txt`.

analysis_options.title: Analysis options
analysis_options.description: ORF prediction, clustering and summary thresholds.

cdslength.description: Minimum ORF length (amino acids) for TransDecoder.

partial.description: Allow partial ORFs. Only complete ORFs are kept by default.

cdhit_as.description: cd-hit-est alignment coverage for the shorter sequence (0 to 1).

threshold.description: Minimum number of reads for a sample to be kept in the filtered TPM tables.

resource_options.title: Resource options
resource_options.description: Threads, memory and parallel samples for the multi-threaded tools.

cores.description: Threads for Trimmomatic, Trinity and Salmon.

forks.description: Maximum number of parallel tasks per process.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).
